title: feat: add HeyGen Video 1 via OpenRouter
author: tomdacatto

gist.summary: Added HeyGen Video 1 (`heygen/heygen-video-1`) via OpenRouter to the existing `GET /video/{prompt}` endpoint, without changing its route or request and response schemas. It accepts text or one start-frame image and generates 5–15-second video at 480p or 768p with synchronized audio; it requires paid Pollen and has no aliases or fallback. Billing uses OpenRouter’s reported cost plus its 5.5% credit fee, falling back to a per-requested-video-second calculation only when the provider reports no cost. HeyGen’s 50% launch rates end after October 2026. The `audio=false` setting still returns audio, a start image can determine the final aspect ratio, and reference-to-video is not exposed.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden studio, Polli wears a tiny director’s beret and watches a single start-frame picture turn into a filmstrip on a retro monitor beside lime green (#ecf874) code-plants; she is a small cute pixel art bee with a yellow body, dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular cheek blush, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, chunky sprites, warm cream and lavender surroundings with dark purple (#110518) outlines, nostalgic but emotionally warm.
